prompt: Create a cinematic vertical full-body portrait of a graceful young Chinese noblewoman in ancient Hanfu, standing slightly left of center and leaning against a dark red wooden pillar in a traditional palace corridor at night. She has black hair styled in an elaborate high updo with curled loops, ornate gold hairpins, dangling beads, and delicate floral head ornaments; her face is pale and refined with soft makeup, downcast eyes, and a melancholic, elegant expression. Dress her in a luxurious layered ivory white Hanfu with translucent gauze sleeves, intricate gold embroidery, dark red and black trim, long flowing fabric, brocade panels, hanging tassels, and a soft white fur stole wrapped around her shoulders and arms. The pose is quiet and intimate: one hand lightly touches her collar or hair ornament, the other gathers the robe, with the fabric cascading to the floor. Set the background as a richly detailed Chinese palace or ancient street with wooden balconies, curved roofs, lantern glow, and wet reflective stone paving, but render it heavily blurred with creamy bokeh and shallow depth of field. Use warm amber lantern light mixed with cool misty shadows, soft haze, filmic contrast, romantic historical drama atmosphere, delicate skin texture, highly detailed costume materials, and a 9:16 vertical composition. No text, no modern objects, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张电影感竖版全身肖像，描绘一位优雅的中国古代年轻贵族女子，身着汉服，略微偏左站立，在夜晚的传统宫廷长廊中倚靠着深红色的木柱。她留着 黑色 的头发，梳着精致的高发髻，配有卷曲的发环、华丽的金簪、垂坠的珠饰和精美的花卉头饰；她的面容苍白而精致，妆容柔和，眼帘低垂，神情忧郁而优雅。为她穿上一件奢华且富有层次感的 象牙白 汉服，配有半透明的纱袖、繁复的金丝刺绣、深红与黑色的镶边、长而飘逸的裙摆、织锦面料、悬挂的流苏，以及一条缠绕在肩臂上的柔软白色毛皮披肩。姿态静谧而亲密：一只手轻轻触碰衣领或发饰，另一只手拢着长袍，衣料垂坠至地面。背景设定为细节丰富的中国宫廷或古街，包含木质阳台、飞檐、灯笼光影和湿润反光的石板路，但背景需经过重度模糊处理，呈现奶油般的虚化效果和浅景深。运用温暖的琥珀色灯笼光与清冷的雾气阴影交织，营造柔和的朦胧感、电影级对比度、浪漫的历史剧氛围，展现细腻的皮肤质感和高度精细的服饰材质，采用 9:16 竖构图。画面中不得包含文字、现代物品或水印。
